title: XPM does not disappoint in the release of his recent track “Problems”
htmlContent:
Talented R&B and Hip hop star XPM is a gifted musical genius who releases heartfelt classics that paint a picture of his origins. With his level of commitment, focus, and determination, all fueled by his love and an unrelenting desire to bring great music, he released his recent single titled "Problems."

In his recent song "Problems," XPM explains the story of maintaining a relationship while chasing your dreams. He shows us what it's like to experience these feelings on the come-up while delivering with a cadence characterized as a fragmented, futuristic take on traditional R&B and Hip Hop.
